claim: Only an AWS account owner, or an AWS account that the owner has delegated rights to, can perform operations on an Amazon SQS message queue. An access policy can also be configured to allow anonymous users to access a message queue.

values.display: allows anonymous users to access a message queue

evidence.quote: Only an AWS account owner (or an AWS account that the account owner has delegated rights to) can perform operations on an Amazon SQS message queue.
Yes. You can configure an access policy that allows anonymous users to access a message queue.
